subject: sepulcra
title: Map 1's music, as agents see it
note: Sepulcra's first music, composed as data (music/map1.json, a pattern sequencer over sound recipes) and measured by the engine's audio_preview: waveform over a log-frequency spectrogram. Map 1's A minor nocturne (one 58 s lap at -29 LUFS: four bars of drone, then bells, choir and a heartbeat pulse), and the victory and defeat cues the game crossfades into.

images.caption: Map 1's theme, one lap: drone alone for four bars, then bells, choir and pulse
Victory cue: F, G, then an A major chord with bells climbing
Defeat cue: the bells fall to a bare low A
